units.source_text: 越接近河流的宽阔流域，地势就越是平坦，由良川的流水仿佛是从山谷里突然出现的。

en.t: The closer one came to the broad basin of the river, the flatter the land became, and the current of the Yura River seemed to appear suddenly out of the valley.

units.source_text: 河水湛蓝，河面宽阔，流水在阴沉沉的灰暗无空下，无可奈何似地缓缓流向大海。

en.t: The river water was deep blue, the river was wide, and under the gloomy gray sky the current drifted slowly toward the sea, as if it had no choice.
